texto: A key competence in B1 is to rebuild stories where past counterfactual conditions (**hätte / wäre + Partizip II**), logical consequences (**hätten wir den Anschlusszug erreicht**) and causal justifications (**weil**, **obwohl**, **deshalb**) are coordinated. The rule of German B1 lies in not isolating the rules, but in applying them together with fluidity and naturality.

filas: Wenn der Zug pünktlich gewesen wäre, ...
obwohl / weil + verb at the end

frases.de: Lukas und Marie mussten zu einer wichtigen Konferenz nach Frankfurt reisen.
frases.es: Lukas y Marie tuvieron que ir a una conferencia importante a Fráncfort.
frases.en: Lukas and Marie had to go to a major conference in Frankfurt.

frases.de: Der Zug hatte aber eine halbe Stunde Verspätung wegen eines Problems auf der Strecke.
frases.es: El tren tuvo, sin embargo, media hora de retraso por un problema en el trayecto.
frases.en: The train was, however, half an hour late because of a problem on the way.

frases.de: Wenn der Zug pünktlich gewesen wäre, hätten wir den Anschlusszug erreicht.
frases.es: Si el tren hubiera llegado puntual, habríamos alcanzado el tren de enlace.
frases.en: If the train had arrived on time, we would have reached the liaison train.

frases.de: Obwohl die Kollegen schnell gelaufen sind, haben sie das Treffen am Nachmittag verpasst.
frases.es: Aunque los compañeros corrieron rápido, perdieron la reunión por la tarde.
frases.en: Although the partners ran fast, they lost the meeting in the afternoon.

frases.de: Deshalb mussten sie am Bahnhof warten, bis der nächste Zug kam.
frases.es: Por eso tuvieron que esperar en la estación hasta que llegó el siguiente tren.
frases.en: That's why they had to wait at the station until the next train arrived.

bloques.pregunta: In the «Wenn der Zug pünktlich gewesen wäre, hätten wir den Anschlusszug erreicht» prayer, what reality does the speaker describe?

opciones.texto: That the train did not arrive on time and, as a result, lost the train.
opciones.explicacion: The structure of Konjunktiv II in the past expresses a hypothetical fact contrary to what happened in reality.

opciones.texto: That the train arrived in advance and had to make time at the station.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the sense of the counterfactual hypothesis.

opciones.texto: That the train never left its city of origin for strike.
opciones.explicacion: The text indicates that the train moved but was late.

bloques.frase: Wenn der Zug pünktlich gewesen wäre, hätten wir den Anschlusszug erreicht.

opciones.texto: If the train had arrived on time, we would have reached the liaison train.
opciones.explicacion: Unreal hypothesis in the past: condition with «wäre» and consequence with «hätten».

opciones.texto: As the train arrived on time, we bought tickets for the link.
opciones.explicacion: It inverts the counterfactual value of prayer.

opciones.texto: If the train arrives on time tomorrow, we will reach the link without fail.
opciones.explicacion: It would express a real condition for the future with an indication.

bloques.frase: Wenn wir das gewusst ___ , hätten wir anders gehandelt.

opciones.explicacion: With «gewusst» in Konjunktiv II of the past, the «hätten» form is used.
It doesn't form the unreal past with participle directly.

bloques.frase: Wenn der Zug pünktlich gewesen ___ , hätten die Kollegen den Anschlusszug erreicht.

opciones.explicacion: With «sein» (gewesen) in past Konjunktiv II, the «wäre» form is used.
It forms the unreal present or future, not the past composed of gewesen.

bloques.pregunta: What verbal order does the conditional subordinate introduced by «Wenn» require?

opciones.texto: The conjugated auxiliary verb («wäre» / «hätte») moves at the absolute end after the participle.
opciones.explicacion: In subordinates with composite times, the conjugated auxiliary closes the clause.

opciones.texto: The conjugated auxiliary is placed in the first position.
opciones.explicacion: It is only placed in position 1 in conditionals without «wenn» conjunction.

opciones.texto: The past participle should be completely omitted.
opciones.explicacion: The participle is essential to give verbal meaning to action.

bloques.pregunta: What connector would you use to express a direct consequence by placing the verb in second position?

opciones.explicacion: «deshalb» is an orational adverbian that occupies position 1 and attracts the verb immediately to position 2.
«weil» is a subordinate conjunction that sends the conjugated verb at the end.
«obwohl» introduces concessional subordinates with verb at the end.

bloques.frase: Wenn der Zug pünktlich gewesen wäre hätten wir den Anschlusszug erreicht
bloques.traduccion: If the train had arrived on time we would have reached the link train
bloques.explicacion: unreal conditional prosthetics in the past and apodosis with investment and auxiliary verb in position two.

intro: At the end of level B1, the challenge is to combine complex prayers that integrate unrealistic hypotheses in Konjunktiv II, causal relationships, double connectors and precise syntactic order.
